goal: flywheel init --skills installs a sixth managed skill, flywheel-ops, whose loop-operating guidance references only CLI verbs and fw docs topics that actually exist.

graders.name: installs-six-with-anchors
graders.run: WT="$PWD" && T=$(mktemp -d) && cd "$T" && git init -qb main && git -c user.email=t@t -c user.name=t commit -qm root --allow-empty && uv run --project "$WT" flywheel init --defaults --skills >/dev/null 2>&1; test -f .claude/skills/flywheel-ops/SKILL.md || { echo 'flywheel-ops not installed'; exit 1; } && grep -q 'managed-by: flywheel init' .claude/skills/flywheel-ops/SKILL.md && test "$(ls .claude/skills | wc -l)" -eq 6 && for a in 'worker' 'status --rollup' 'live' 'history' 'show' 'parked' 'stranded' 'fw docs'; do grep -q -- "$a" .claude/skills/flywheel-ops/SKILL.md || { echo "missing anchor: $a"; exit 1; }; done

graders.name: operability-screen
assertions: Reading only the rendered flywheel-ops skill, an agent could start the worker, drain a phase, and check its status. MET or UNMET.
The skill explains how to diagnose a parked worktree and the concrete recovery path. MET or UNMET.
The skill explains what a stranded DONE landing means and how to recover it. MET or UNMET.

relevant: packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_skills.py -- SKILL_NAMES registry and the five existing managed templates; the new template lives here
packages/flywheel-orchestrator/tests/test_skills.py -- keep green; extend for the sixth skill
packages/flywheel/src/flywheel/_cli.py -- read-only: the router's verb sets the seam test validates against

packages/flywheel/tests/test_ops_skill_surface.py -- NEW: the seam holdout; every fw/flywheel verb token in the rendered template must be in the router's dispatch sets, every named docs topic in the curated topic-set constant
constraints: The seam test imports the router verb sets and the curated topic constant -- never a copied list (the flywheel dist already depends on the orchestrator, so the product tests can see both sides)
The template renders with the same managed-by header and install mechanics as the existing five
Commit the change with a clear message before reporting done
non_goals: Do not modify the five existing skill templates' content
Do not add or rename router verbs to make a skill reference real -- the skill conforms to the CLI, never the reverse
Do not weaken or delete existing tests
edge_cases: A verb mentioned in prose (e.g. 'fw show RUN_ID') must validate the verb token, not the placeholder argument
The skill must direct agents to 'fw docs <topic>' for depth rather than duplicating doc content inline
